title: Vue Counter
description: Build an interactive counter with Vue 3 using Options API

steps.title: Create a Vue App
steps.description: Use Vue.createApp() to create a Vue app with a data function that returns { count: 0 }. Mount it to #root. In the template, display the count in an <h1> and the count in a <p> tag.
hints: Template is a property: { data() { return { count: 0 } }, template: '...' }
Display count with {{ count }} in the template

verification.successMessage: Vue app renders with the counter!

steps.title: Add Methods
steps.description: Add a methods section with increment() and decrement() functions that modify the count. Add two buttons in the template that call these methods on click.
hints: Methods go in { data() { ... }, methods: { increment() { this.count++ }, decrement() { this.count-- } } }

verification.successMessage: Buttons render and methods are defined!
verification.failureMessage: Add increment and decrement methods with + and - buttons

steps.title: Computed Property
steps.description: Add a computed property isEven that returns true if count is even. Display 'Even' or 'Odd' next to the count.
hints: Computed goes in { data() { ... }, computed: { isEven() { return this.count % 2 === 0 } } }

verification.successMessage: Computed property shows Even or Odd correctly!
verification.failureMessage: Add a computed property isEven and display it

steps.title: Watch the Count
steps.description: Add a watch section that watches count. When count changes, log the new value to the console with console.log('Count changed to', newValue).
hints: Watch syntax: watch: { count(newVal) { console.log('Count changed to', newVal); } }

verification.successMessage: Watcher logs count changes — great job!
verification.failureMessage: Add a watch for count that logs changes
